'''2010 Malastare Regionals Chris Montgomery LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Montgomery]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Xwings
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
